content.title: Chapter 26 - CIVIL EMERGENCY, EMERGENCY, OR LOCAL DISASTER — Sec. 26-37. - Succession of authority.
content.summary:
If the city manager is unavailable, the line of succession of authority shall include
               in order: the deputy city managers in order of position seniority, followed by the

           …

faqs.a:
If the city manager is unavailable, the line of succession of authority shall include
               in order: the deputy city managers in order of position seniority, followed by the
               public works director, community and economic development director, the finance director,
               then any other department head in alphabetical order of the name of the department.
               In the event none of these people are available to serve as the acting city manager,
               the deputy director of the various departments in the line of succession as indicated
               shall service in such capacity.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 2, 12-5-2022)
